source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第七节

textbook_summary: Downward-scooped ST depression, initially negative then narrow upright terminal T and shortened QT; digitalis effect is not a toxicity inference.
limitations: One fixed contour and electrode vector, not a digitized patient ECG
No drug dose, concentration, toxicity or arrhythmia model
Other digitalis T variants and other drug effects remain open
